name: spotify
description: Realtime Spotify clone — Next.js 16 + NestJS 12 + MongoDB

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @spotify/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @spotify/shared" "npm run dev -w @spotify/backend" "npm run dev -w @spotify/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @spotify/shared && npm run build -w @spotify/backend && npm run build -w @spotify/frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run start:prod -w @spotify/backend" "npm run start -w @spotify/frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @spotify/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
